01

“The Hour has come near, and the moon has split”

An explanation (Q 54:1).

01
Report 01

Report 01

English
Transmission wording
The trustworthy shaykh Abu al-Saud al-Mubarak ibn Khayrun ibn Abd al-Malik ibn al-Hasan ibn Khayrun informed us, by recitation to him while I listened, and he affirmed it in Jumada al-Ula of the year 541 [AH]; he said: Abu al-Fadl Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Khayrun informed us, by recitation to him while I listened, and he affirmed it in Shawwal of the year 482 [sic]; he said: Abu Ali al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn Ibrahim ibn al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Shadhan informed us; he said: Ibrahim ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Kisai al-Razi related to us, saying: Adam ibn Abi Iyas related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Husayn ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mutim, from his father, from his grandfather, on His words:
The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [al-Qamar 1] he said: "The moon split while we were in Mecca."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ الثِّقَةُ أَبُو السُّعُودِ الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ خَيْرُونَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خَيْرُونَ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ، فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ فِي جُمَادَى الْأُولَى مِنْ سَنَةِ إِحْدِى وَأَرْبَعِينَ وَخَمْسِمِائَةٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْفَضْلِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خَيْرُونَ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ فِي شَوَّالٍ مِنْ سَنَةِ اثْنَتَيْنِ وَثَمَانِينَ وَأَرْبَعِمِائَةٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْكِسَائِيُّ الرَّازِيُّ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ فِي قَوْلِهِ:
اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ [القمر: 1] قَالَ: «انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ وَنَحْنُ بِمَكَّةَ»
Edition record 373493 · p. 633Link to report ↗
02

“and they say, 'Passing magic'”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 54:2).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and they say, 'Passing magic' [al-Qamar 2] that is: "magic that passes away."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَيَقُولُوا سِحْرٌ مُسْتَمِرٌّ [القمر: 2] أَيْ: «سِحْرٌ ذَاهِبٌ»
Edition record 373494 · p. 633Link to report ↗
03

“in which there is deterrence [muzdajar]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 54:4).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
in which there is deterrence [muzdajar] [al-Qamar 4] he said: "meaning admonition, meaning a limit."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ [القمر: 4] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي مَوْعِظَةً، يَعْنِي مُنْتَهَى»

04

“and he was repelled”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 54:9).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and he was repelled [al-Qamar 9] meaning: "he was driven mad."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَازْدُجِرَ [القمر: 9] يَعْنِي: «اسْتُطِيرَ جُنُونًا»

05

“as a reward for him who had been denied [kufira]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 54:14).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
as a reward for him who had been denied [kufira] [al-Qamar 14] he said: He says: "kufira, He says: a recompense from God."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
جَزَاءً لِمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ [القمر: 14] قَالَ: يَقُولُ: " كُفِرَ يَقُولُ: جَزَاءً مِنَ اللَّهِ "

06

“And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 54:17).

Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

08

“every [day of] drink will be attended”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 54:28).

09
Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
every [day of] drink will be attended [al-Qamar 28] He says: "they would attend the water when the she-camel was away, and when she came and drank the water, they would be present for the milk."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُحْتَضَرٌ [القمر: 28] يَقُولُ: «يُحْضِرُونَ هُمُ الْمَاءَ إِذَا غَابَتِ النَّاقَةُ فَإِذَا جَاءَتْ فَشَرِبَتِ الْمَاءَ أَحْضَرُوا هُمُ اللَّبَنَ»
Edition record 373501 · p. 635Link to report ↗
